description: Renames one tag in the vault's own vocabulary — `kind` says which list, commitment, member or account — and carries every row wearing it, the owner's tag groups too. A name another tag of that kind already wears is refused. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

from.description: The tag as the vault holds it, any casing.

kind.description: Which list the tag belongs to.

to.description: The new name, in the owner's words.

name: rename_tag
title: Rename a tag
